summary: Checks whether a value is a sheet id.
description: Apps Script numbers its sheets from zero, so a sheet id is a non-negative safe integer — the same rule `isCountable` applies. The id of the first sheet in a spreadsheet is `0`.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).
returns: `true` when the value is a sheet id; otherwise `false`.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
isValidSheetId(0); // => true
isValidSheetId(1234567890); // => true
isValidSheetId(-1); // => false
isValidSheetId(1.5); // => false
isValidSheetId("0"); // => false
```
